purpose: Teach: 宿舎/華麗/赤外線/右脳/速記/接着/解像度/諸島

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、部活合宿で宿舎泊まったろ?
lines.en: So you stayed overnight at your club camp, right Riku?
lines.style: Casual, direct opening. Quick rhythm, light curiosity in the voice. No edge — just asking what she already suspects he'll confirm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ダンス部の華麗な衣装似合ってたぞ、桜
lines.en: Your dance outfit looked really sharp on you, Sakura.
lines.style: Steady, sincere tone without over-performing. Slight warmth on the compliment but delivered like it's just fact. Brief eye contact level in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、赤外線サーモグラフィー使った実験やったろ?
lines.en: Did you do that infrared thermography experiment thing?
lines.style: Playful push forward. Quicker tempo, testing his attention span. A small smile audible — she knows he notices details others miss.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、右脳タイプの試験得意だったな、桜
lines.en: You're good at that right-brain kind of stuff, aren't you Sakura.
lines.style: Dry observation, half-amused at himself for noticing. Casual rhythm, like he's thinking out loud. Not quite a question, more a checkpoint.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、速記みたいに早くノート取るな
lines.en: You take notes insanely fast, like you're doing shorthand or something.
lines.style: Bright and direct. Picks up tempo mid-sentence. The tone of someone impressed and not hiding it, but keeping it light to avoid embarrassing him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、接着剤の工作得意だな、桜
lines.en: You're pretty good at hands-on stuff with glue and putting things together, Sakura.
lines.style: Measured observation, slightly matter-of-fact. Warm undertone but grounded — not gushing. The voice of someone genuinely noticing and just saying it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のスマホ、解像度すごいな
lines.en: Your phone screen is really high resolution.
lines.style: Open curiosity with genuine interest. Softer attack, like he's checking if she's noticed the same thing. Slightly tentative — testing if this observation lands.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で諸島の地理勉強したろ?桜
lines.en: You studied the geography of the islands in social studies, didn't you Sakura.
lines.style: Warm, closer in tone — slightly softer attack. A little leaning-in quality, like he's checking in with her specifically. Conversational, not distant.
